top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 86 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The 86 FEC request-for-additional-information (RFAI) letters and Form 99 filings received since October 24, 2026 were all covered in prior editions, so none are repeated here. No red-flag keyword hits turned up, and no new voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more were found.

The voided and negative transactions check did not complete cleanly. The FEC's Schedule A query timed out with an HTTP 504 error, so that part of the scan may be incomplete. The deadline, megadonor, Money Out and outside-money checks also found nothing new.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 24, 2026 onward, through the afternoon of Tuesday, October 27, 2026 (PM edition). Eighty-six filings fell in the window and all were already reported; none are new.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: The NASA picture-of-the-day page layout changed, so its image, title and explanation could not be found. The FEC Schedule A fetch for voided and negative transactions failed with HTTP 504 (query timed out), so negative-amount transactions may be incomplete.
